en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over gently rolling fields leading up to a cluster of substantial late‑19th‑century houses and institutional buildings. In the foreground is a small pond and grassy embankments with a few trees and farm structures to the right. On the horizon stands a prominent multi‑storey mansion or school‑like building with ornate rooflines, flanked by villas; farther right, a tall, slender church spire rises above trees. The image has irregularly cut borders typical of an old photographic postcard. No visible caption or printed text appears on the front.
